title: CP56Time2a bitstring command request
purpose: Exercise the bitstring command parser with a time-tagged control ASDU and a complete I-format APDU.
expected_behavior: The receiver should parse the APDU and ASDU as a C_BO_TA_1 activation request with one information object, then handle it according to normal IEC60870 control-direction processing without process termination.
constraints_preserved: The APCI length 0x18 represents the four APCI control bytes plus a 20-byte ASDU.
The ASDU type identifier 33 denotes C_BO_TA_1 according to supplied function-code documentation.
The ASDU uses VSQ 1, COT 6 with positive activation semantics, common address 1, and one three-byte information object address.

The four-byte bitstring and seven-byte CP56Time2a fields are zero-valued boundary-neutral contents; their exact semantic encoding is an inferred assumption, not externally verified by the supplied excerpts.
The send and receive sequence fields are zero-valued, following the standard I-format layout as an inferred assumption.
issue_safety_notes: This is a structurally guided analogue for parser and dispatch coverage based on issue 13, not a copy of the historical input. It changes the type, length, and payload structure and preserves complete framing.
